title: STIMPulseControl Ancillary Speech Study
summary: Speech assessment is a substudy to the STIMPulseControl study (hereinafter referred to as the main study), where audio recordings of patients voices will be recorded as part of a speech analysis in the main study, for this optional ancillary study.

interventions.name: bilateral high frequency deep brain stimulation of the subthalamic neucleus combined with best medical treatment according to widely accepted expert consensus paper
best medical treatment for management of impulse control in Parkinson´s disease according to widely accepted expert consensus paper
